text: Eisdon Gate Control, Kestrel two niner, at the gate one holding point. Requesting clearance to transit to Harron.
Kestrel two niner, Eisdon Gate Control. State the nature of your business in Harron.
Bulk freighter. Twelve hundred tonnes of refined ore for the Harron docks.
Copy. Transmit clearance code.
Clearance code Delta four seven Kilo.
Code verified. Kestrel two niner, cleared to enter gate one, Harron lane. Spool window in sixty seconds.
Entering gate one for Harron. Kestrel two niner.
Harron Gate Control, Halcyon four one, requesting gate two to Zirndorf.
Halcyon four one, Harron Control. What are you carrying?
Passenger liner, four hundred aboard. Tourism charter to the Zirndorf rings.
Say clearance code.
Sierra one one Tango.
Code checks. Halcyon four one, cleared gate two. Go when the ring goes green.
Gate two on green. Halcyon four one.
Vessel approaching gate three, Secara Gate Control. Identify and state your destination.
Secara Control, Mule seven seven, cargo hauler, bound for Valrad.
Mule seven seven, say clearance code.
Romeo two niner Echo.
Verified. You are number four in the queue for gate three. Hold at the marker.
Number four for gate three. Holding at the marker. Mule seven seven.
Zirndorf Gate Control, Lantern six, private yacht, eight souls aboard. Requesting transit to Eisdon.
Lantern six, Zirndorf Control. Purpose of travel?
Sightseeing. We want a look at the Eisdon approaches before the season ends.
Copy. Clearance code, please.
Bravo eight eight Lima.
Lantern six, code verified. Cleared gate four, Eisdon lane. Spool window in ninety seconds.
Gate four, ninety seconds. Thank you, Control.
Permeya Gate Control, Corsair one zero, escort lead. Requesting group transit for three ships to Secara. Clearance code Hotel five two Victor.
Corsair one zero, group code verified. What is the convoy carrying?
Medical stores and reactor fuel cells. Insured cargo.
Copy. Escort enters gate two first. Convoy follows at thirty second intervals.
Escort first, thirty second intervals. Corsair one zero.
Valrad Gate Control, Drover five three, at gate one. Request clearance to Bretoria. Code November three three Alpha.
Drover five three, code checks. Where are you headed after Bretoria?
Back to Permeya, then home.
Copy. Cleared gate one. Contact Bretoria Control on exit.
Contact Bretoria on exit. Drover five three.
Bretoria Gate Control, Pilgrim nine, requesting gate three to Eisdon. Six hundred passengers for the shrines.
Pilgrim nine, Bretoria Control. Transmit clearance code.
Code Foxtrot one six Juliet.
Verified. Cleared gate three. Passenger traffic has priority two. Hold your vector through the ring.
Holding vector through the ring. Pilgrim nine.
Harron Gate Control, Ferry two two, crew transfer, forty personnel for rotation at Secara station.
Ferry two two, Harron Control. Say clearance code.
Tango six zero Mike.
Code verified. Cleared to enter gate one, Secara lane, behind the outbound freighter.
Behind the freighter, gate one. Ferry two two.
Eisdon Gate Control, Basalt one four, mining tender, returning to the Theta belt via gate two.
Basalt one four, Eisdon Control. Code, please.
Uniform four four Charlie.
Verified. Gate two is spooling now. You are clear to enter.
Entering gate two. Basalt one four.
Kestrel eight, Zirndorf Gate Control. You are next for gate one. Confirm destination Harron.
Confirmed, Harron. Sealed dispatches for the Harron administration.
Copy, courier priority. Gate one is spooling. Contact Harron Control on exit. Good transit.
Contact Harron on exit. Kestrel eight.
Secara Gate Control, Wayfarer three, requesting clearance through gate two to Permeya. Survey vessel, mapping the lane drift.
Wayfarer three, Secara Control. How long will you hold in the lane?
Four hours, Control. Slow transit with sensors deployed.
Copy. Slow transit approved. Stay out of the main traffic channel. Transmit clearance code.
Whiskey seven one Delta.
Verified. Cleared gate two, slow lane.
Slow lane, gate two. Wayfarer three.
Valrad Gate Control, Gannet five one, request gate four to Zirndorf. Salvage tug with a derelict hull under tow.
Gannet five one, say length of tow.
Three hundred meters, Control.
Copy. You will need the wide ring. Cleared gate four after the liner exits. Code, please.
Code Papa two two Oscar.
Verified. Hold until the liner clears, then proceed.
Holding for the liner. Gannet five one.
Harron Gate Control, Drover one three, exiting gate one, inbound from Eisdon.
Drover one three, Harron Control. Welcome to Harron. What brings you in?
Construction alloys for the new station ring.
Copy that. Clear the gate one exit and proceed on vector two one four to the cargo docks.
Clearing gate one, vector two one four. Drover one three.
Eisdon Gate Control, Halcyon nine, exiting gate three, inbound from Secara. Tour liner, eleven hundred passengers.
Halcyon nine, welcome to Eisdon. Proceed to the passenger terminal on vector zero four five.
Requesting a slow pass of the station ring for our passengers.
Slow pass approved. Stay above the traffic plane and keep clear of the gate three exit.
Above the plane. Passengers say thank you, Control.
Zirndorf Gate Control, Talon four, exiting gate two from Permeya. Escort for a diplomatic shuttle.
Talon four, Zirndorf Control. Diplomatic shuttle confirmed. Say clearance code.
Code Kilo niner niner Echo.
Verified. Escort the shuttle to the Authority berth on vector one eight zero. Traffic is holding for you.
Authority berth, vector one eight zero. Talon four.
Secara Gate Control, Quill two, exiting gate four, inbound from Valrad. Medical transport.
Quill two, Secara Control. Do you require priority?
Affirmative. Three patients in critical condition.
Priority granted. Direct to the hospital docks. All traffic, give way to Quill two.
Direct to the hospital docks. Thank you, Secara.
Permeya Gate Control, Cinder six one, exiting gate one from Bretoria. Water ice for the colony.
Cinder six one, Permeya Control. Manifest received. Proceed to the customs buoy for inspection.
Customs buoy. Cinder six one.
Bretoria Gate Control, Vesper three, out of gate two, inbound from Harron. Private yacht.
Vesper three, Bretoria Control. Welcome. What is the purpose of your visit?
Holiday, Control. Two weeks at the Bretoria resorts.
Enjoy your stay. Proceed to the yacht marina on vector three three zero.
Yacht marina, three three zero. Vesper three.
Valrad Gate Control, Tern four four, exiting gate three from Eisdon. Hydroponic grain.
Tern four four, Valrad Control. Clear the exit, traffic is right behind you.
Clearing now. Request berth assignment.
Freight berth seven. Vector one two two.
Berth seven, one two two. Tern four four.
Harron Gate Control, Harrow one, request gate three to Bretoria. Code Lima four zero Zulu.
Harrow one, code checks. Cleared gate three.
Gate three. Harrow one.
All traffic, Eisdon Gate Control. Gate two is cycling. Hold outside the marker until the ring goes green.
Mule two two, holding outside the marker.
Zirndorf Gate Control, Bastion five, inbound gate three. Request docking clearance.
Bastion five, cleared to dock at berth eleven. Watch for the outbound tug.
Berth eleven. Bastion five.
Kestrel four, Secara Control. You are drifting off the gate one approach. Correct your vector.
Correcting now. Sorry, Control.
Secara Gate Control, Pilgrim two, how long is the queue for gate two?
Pilgrim two, six ships ahead of you. Expect about twelve minutes.
Copy, twelve minutes. Pilgrim two.
Permeya Gate Control, Ferry one, requesting a return transit through gate four. Same manifest as this morning.
Ferry one, I have your manifest. Clearance code still valid. Cleared gate four.
Cleared four. Ferry one.
Eisdon Gate Control, Corsair three, say again, you were breaking up.
Corsair three, Eisdon Control. I say again, hold short of gate one. Traffic is exiting.
Holding short of gate one. Corsair three.
Halcyon six, Bretoria Control. Your clearance code is expired. Report to inspection berth four before transit.
Inspection berth four. Halcyon six.
Valrad Gate Control, Gannet two, convoy of five ore haulers ready at gate one. Request group clearance to Secara.
Gannet two, Valrad Control. Group clearance approved. Thirty second spacing. Escort squawk on.
Thirty second spacing, squawk on. Gannet two.
Harron Gate Control, Mule one four, requesting gate two to Eisdon.
Mule one four, be advised, the Eisdon lane is under caution. Escort squawk mandatory. Expect delays.
Copy caution. We will wait for the next convoy.
Copy. Next convoy departs in twenty minutes. Hold at the marker.
Holding at the marker. Mule one four.
All traffic, Secara Gate Control. The Permeya lane through gate three is under caution. Reduced throughput until further notice.
Tern five, copies caution, gate three.
Zirndorf Gate Control, Lantern two, why the hold on gate one?
Lantern two, lane caution in effect. Only escorted traffic is moving. You are in the next group.
Understood. Lantern two.
Eisdon Gate Control, Corsair eight, escort for two freighters. Request gate one through the caution lane to Harron.
Corsair eight, approved. Keep your freighters tight and your transponders hot. Cleared gate one.
Tight formation, transponders hot. Corsair eight.
Permeya Gate Control, Drover two, at gate two. Requesting clearance to Harron. Code Echo one five Romeo.
Drover two, negative. The Harron lane is closed by order of the Authority. Gate two is locked down.
Copy. Is there an alternate route?
Divert through Secara via gate three. Expect a long wait.
Diverting via Secara. Drover two.
Kestrel five, Valrad Gate Control. You are drifting into the gate four exclusion zone. That lane is closed. Turn away now.
Turning away. Apologies, Control.
Notice to all traffic, Eisdon Gate Control. Gate three is closed. Repeat, closed. Divert via alternate gates.
Halcyon two, copies. Diverting.
Harron Gate Control, Basalt two, requesting transit to Eisdon.
Basalt two, Eisdon is at war. State your business.
Medical supplies for the civilian hospitals.
Copy. Civilian transit is at your own risk. Military traffic has gate priority. Cleared after the patrol group.
After the patrol group. Basalt two.
All stations, Permeya Gate Control. System status, conflict. All civilian departures are on hold. Military traffic only.
Talon one, copies. Patrol group ready at gate one.
Talon one, cleared gate one. Good hunting.
Unidentified vessel on approach to gate two, Harron Gate Control. Identify immediately or you will be intercepted.
Harron Control, Wayfarer six. Transponder fault. We are a civilian survey ship.
Wayfarer six, hold position. A patrol will escort you in.
